precision: Target W8A8; Draft FP16; GDN recurrent cache FP32 for ordinary and DFlash inputs/outputs; conv and KV FP16
ordinary_state_policy: ordinary Chunk GDR prefill/decode preserves FP32 state without FP16 round trip
verify_policy: one MTP call per GDN layer; Target Top1 and prefix acceptance; gather conv/recurrent slot a after anchor plus a accepted proposals

mtp_operator.initial_state: FP32[1,16,32,128,128], seeded per layer from committed scalar state
mtp_operator.accepted_tokens: INT8[1] zero selects initial slot; not the current acceptance count

valid_rows: INT16[1] restricts mask, acceptance and selected state; MTP computes all 16 physical rows
capsules: two internal banks per GDN layer: conv FP16 and recurrent FP32
target_gates: MTP named GE ABI and Meta
one MTP GE node per GDN layer in Verify
no second Chunk GDR in Verify
3+10 real device and requested output-comparison policy
shared_bundle_policy: two route manifests in one directory reference three identical common artifacts; source/configuration/ABI/ATC identity and options must match
draft_valid_rows: INT16[1], 0..R where R is the selected 16/64 gear; generation appends 1..16 rows
draft_policy: one Draft OM; 64-row gear for long-prompt preparation, final prompt block in first useful proposal call, then 16-row generation gear
memory_policy: reuse existing 64-row feature buffer and current/next KV banks; one Draft model plus CANN dynamic-control input; physical gear weights/workspace/peak require device validation
native_plan_policy: draft_prefill_policy single_draft16_64_gears is mandatory; re-export AIR, recompile OMs and regenerate old plans
runtime_input_abi: public-tensor-storage-identity-v1; normalize GE Data index/order; only Draft features axis 1 may be -1; runtime validates exact 16/64 gear descriptors
